Labels.description: Caller-supplied or observed public labels; labels never grant capabilities. There are at most 32 entries; UTF-8 keys are at most 63 bytes and values at most 255 bytes, with NUL forbidden. The ASCII-escaped serialized map is bounded to 64 KiB. Provider-internal ownership, identity and grant metadata is separate and is never returned as labels.
